translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aar Fenai Rhaepeto Kkewe
Iwe aaemweoi Pharisees me sinsein anniug ra itto reen Jesus saengi Jerusalem nge ra aeiineow pwe,
“Meeta rhooan kkayeo kkomwu noawumw rese tapweei aar fenai rhaepeto kkewe aarh reen? Rese tapweei wunuunun toatoan pai mmwaen aar repwe mwongo!”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Iwe ina meeta oawse tapweei aaen Deus anniug reen pwe oawwa tapweei ina kkomi?
Pwe Deus a aepesa pwe, ‘Wopwe aesirowuur semoamw me inoamw’ iwe me, ‘Iyo e oari seman aere inan nge repwe niiy noa.’
Nge aaemi oawwa aengaeniir aeremas pwe aere eyor minne erhai epwe tipaengi ngaeni seman aere inan, nge a iura pwe, ‘Ieen aaen Deus,’
nge ese aenneew igine ese aesirowu no seman. Ieei minne oawwa oatoranoa aaen anniug Deus pwe aaemi oawpwe feeori minna kkomi.
Aaemi rhooa oatupwutupw! A gin weneeti minne we Isaiah e fenaiuw pwe wunuunumi!

content.text: ‘Deus a aepesa pwe: Aeremas kkeei ra oassoamwooniaei rhag reen aar kkepas,
nge nee tipeer a igin taaw saengiaei.
pwe re fenaiuw aar aeremas anniug,
nge ra feeori pwe aetae gaen aaei anniug!’ ”

content: Minikka e Aenimaenneewa Aeremas
Iwe Jesus a faingiir to pwuwaen aeremas kkewe nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw aiussaening pwe oawpwe metaf!
Saapw meeta kka etonong noan ewaemi minne epwe aenimaenneewagaemi, pwe faer meeta kka etowow me noan minne a aenimaenneewagaemi.”
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra itto reen Jesus nge ra aengaeni pwe, “Wa giuneei pwe ra soong Pharisees kkewe reen meeta we wo aepesa?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Oanongan waniwan kka miniwe Semaei noan naaeng ese foatogi epwe wiwiytae.
Oawsoapw niunniuwaenneer iir! Iir ikkomwu rhooa parh nge re paaepae rhooa parh. Ngaere erhai man parh e paeni pwan erhai man parh, nge iir me riiurhai repwe ppiungiunong nee niipw.”
Peter a aengaeni pwe, “Wopwe aemmetefa ngaenigemaem meeta faaen kkepas eei.”
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawsaaen metaf noa mwo?
Oawse metaf? Pwe meeta kka a toonong noan ewaemi pwan toonong noan upwaemi, mwirin a toowow me noan oanongaemi.
Nge meeta kka retowow saengi ewaemi rhaep saengi pwunnomi, nge ikkaan minikka e aenimaenneewagaemi.
Pwe saengi noan pwunnomi a toowow niunniuwaen aenneew taeppen, nni menaw, maiur ngaeni pwiuniuwaen erhai, ffeeor aenneew, mwoarho, oatupwutupw me aenneewa noa iteer aaemweoi.
Ikkaan minikka e aenimaenneewagaemi. Iwe nge erhai e mwongo nge ese tapweei wunuunun toatoan pai, minneen esoapw aenimaenneewagaemi.”
Aaen Niugiuniug Erhai Rhooapwut
Jesus a noa saengi pwiuneoi we nge a noa noan faniuw kkewe oaron aepinoamwon Tyre me Sidon.
Erhai rhooapwuton Canaan e nonno pwiuneoi we a itto reen, nge a aepwesaegini pwe, “Soamwoon, Naiun David! Faayeowaei! Rhooapwut na naeyi a wartae aniu aenneew wooan nge a igin cchoaw noa.”
Nge Jesus ese aengaeni mwo eew petenaen kkepas. Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra itto reen nge ra tingoar gacch ngaeni pwe, “Aefenganoa nieei! Ettapw fetaen rhag me mwirirh nge e igin soaw oacchorong!”
Iwe Jesus a aepesa pwe, “Deus e aefengaeyaei to rhag pwe reer re Israel kkewe ra weer sheep kkewe re mwaenirh noa.”
Iwe rhag nge rhooapwut we a itto foatotiw weni mmwan nge a iura pwe, “Soamwoon, tipaengiaei!”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ese mwamwaai pwe sipwe pwigi aeneer wonigaet mwongo nge sa oatora ngaeniir gonaag.”
Iwe niewe a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ennet minna, Soamwoon, nge gonaag mwo nge re angi peipeyin mwongo ppiungiutiw saengi aar maasta table.”
Iwe Jesus a paniuwaeni niewe pwe, “Een erhai rhooapwut e igin faeregit oamw niugiuniug! Meeta na oamw mwerhaen nge epwe yo ngaeniug.” Iwe noan rhag oaton we nge rhooapwut we naiun a takketae.
Jesus e Aecchipwaar Rhooa Towunap Kkewe
Jesus a noa saengi pwiuneoi we nge a noa faaeraeg ngaerhen meoneoiniuniun Galilee. A ittae wooan eew rhug a ittae mooat tiw.

Towunepaen aeremas kkewe ra itto reen, pwigito rhooawe re pirhemae, rhooa parh, rhooa maemerhoar, rhooa se kkepas, me pwan towunepaen aeremas kka re semwaai ra itto iseniir tiw oaron pirheen Jesus; iwe a aecchipwaar tae oanongeer.

Aeremas ra mwaar reen meeta we ra weri pwe igiwe rhooawe rese kkepas ra kkepas, rhooawe re maemerhoar ra mamaaw noa, rhooawe re pirhemae ra faaeraeg, pwan rhooawe reparh ra weri mmweer. Iwe, ra aepingepinga Deus we naiiur re Israel.
Jesus e Oamwongoor Faangeras Aeremas

Jesus a faingiir to rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Ngaang iya faayeeor aeremas kaan, pwe ra no reei noan eoniuraen nge esooar meeta minne repwe angi. Ngaang ise mwerhaen aefengaar noa noan aar pecchai, pwe repwe tongaeni niyoarorhrorh iga repwe faaeraeg ngaeni imweer.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra aeiineow pwe, “Iya me noan pwiuneoi anniug noa eei minne sipwe weriwer mwongo me ee pwe epwe nap ngaeniir towunepeer aeremas kaan?”
Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Fitifai fenoawa eyor reemi?” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Fiusiufai fenoawa me fitiman iig mwittig.”
Iwe Jesus a aepesa ngaeniir aeremas kkewe pwe repwe mooat tiw weni ppweon.
A pwigi fenoawa kkewe fiusiufai me iig kkewe nge a fang ngaeni Deus aan aerhigerhig, a giniytiw nge a ngaenneer rhooan kkayeo kkewe, nge rhooan kkayeo ra ngaeniir aeremas kkewe.
Oanongeer ra mwongo nge ra faeyemwaai. Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra oawuta fisuuw rhiug reen nusegin mwongo kkewe.
Nneogeoiiur mwaaen kkewe re mwongo nge faangeras, nge rese paaepaenong rhooapwut me wonigaet.
Iwe Jesus a fangenoa aeremas kkewe, nge a teeotae wooan pwoot we nge a saei ngaeni miniwe faniuwaen Magadan.
